events.name: Steamwheedle Cartel Merchant
events.text: A goblin of the Steamwheedle Cartel waves you over from a heap of crates. "Friend! Best prices in Kalimdor, guaranteed!"

options.label: Haggle him down: take 20 gold and 1 Weak

events.name: Sayge's Fortune
events.text: Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire shuffles his deck. "Choose your path, and I shall tell you what the stars hold."

options.label: Fortune of Intelligence (+1 Energy, draw 1 on turn 1)

events.name: Wandering Argent Dawn Paladin
events.text: A weary paladin of the Argent Dawn offers a blessing against the Scourge, for a modest donation to the cause.

events.name: Rest at the Inn
events.text: Warm fire, hot stew, and a quiet corner. The innkeeper binds your hearthstone here.

options.label: Buy a round for the house (30 gold)

events.name: The Trapped Chest
events.text: A battered iron chest sits half-buried. A thin wire runs from the lock into the earth.

events.name: Gnomish Gadget Gamble
events.text: A gnome engineer from Gnomeregan hands you an unlabeled contraption. "It definitely works! Probably! Mostly!"

options.label: Activate it (50%: rare gadget, else 8 damage)

events.name: The Twilight Tome
events.text: A cultist of the Twilight's Hammer dropped this tome. Its pages whisper of power, and of a price.

options.label: Read the forbidden passage (+3 Strength, gain Curse)
Sell it to a Kirin Tor scholar

events.name: Kirin Tor Apprentice
events.text: A harried apprentice of the Kirin Tor can teleport you ahead, if his spell holds.

events.name: Timbermaw Trading Post
events.text: The Timbermaw furbolgs eye you warily, then nod. Trade is welcome among friends.

options.label: Trade for a Furbolg Medicine Pouch (30 gold)
Share a meal by the fire

events.name: A Dying Soldier's Last Request
events.text: A wounded soldier presses a sealed letter into your hand. "Take this to my family... please."

options.label: Promise to deliver it (-20 gold, +5 max HP)
Give him a healing draught (-5 HP, +10 max HP)
Take his purse (+70 gold, gain Curse)

events.name: Earthmother's Blessing
events.text: An elder of the Tauren lays a gnarled hand on your brow. "The Earthmother sees you, little one."

events.name: Nesingwary's Hunting Party
events.text: Hemet Nesingwary's expedition is tallying kills and paying bounties on the big game. "Care to join the hunt?"

options.label: Join the hunt (take 8 damage, earn 90 gold)
